Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning prevailing wages for workers employed in residential construction.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prevailing wages for workers employed inresidential construction; and adding a new section to chapter 39.12RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 39.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Distinct prevailing wage rates shall be calculated and paid toworkers employed in residential construction. "Residentialconstruction" means construction alteration, repair improvement, ormaintenance of singlefamily dwellings, duplexes, apartments,condominiums, and other residential structures not to exceed fourstories in height, and all incidental items such as site work, parkingareas, utilities, and streets and sidewalks, pursuant to the UnitedStates department of labor's "All Agency Memorandum No. 130:Application of the Standard of Comparison "Projects of a CharacterSimilar" under the DavisBacon and Related Acts," dated March 17, 1978.
